meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将工作分解为可执行的系统步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将复杂目标拆解为有条理的行动步骤
copy.tagline_en: Decompose work into systematic, actionable steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to break down complex goals into methodical steps

howto.what: 当您要求进行目标分解或长期任务时，Claude会按照“超工作模式”将工作拆解为基于证据的步骤，并跟踪每个步骤的完成状态。它还会记录证据，确保每个目标都有可验证的成果。
howto.when: 当您提到“ulw-loop”、“ulw”或“目标执行”等关键词，或要求进行带检查点的长期交付时触发。

say.text: 开始一个ulw-loop会话，分解我的目标。
say.note: Claude会读取完整工作流程，创建目标并开始执行。
Claude会检查现有目标状态，并继续执行下一步。

say.text: 为ulw-loop创建一个新目标，会话ID为new-session。
say.note: Claude会使用指定ID创建全新的目标会话。

howto.what_en: When you ask for goal decomposition or long-running tasks, Claude will break work into evidence-bound steps using ultrawork mode, track each step's progress, and record evidence to verify success criteria.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "ulw-loop", "ulw", "goal execution", or ask for checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Start a ulw-loop session to decompose my goals.
say_en.note: Claude reads the full workflow, creates goals, and begins execution.

say_en.text: Execute ulw-loop to continue the current task.
say_en.note: Claude checks existing goal state and proceeds with the next step.

say_en.text: Create a new ulw-loop goal with session ID new-session.
say_en.note: Claude creates a brand-new goal session with the specified ID.
